facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/detec.upgrade_config: upgrade a detectron2 config CfgNode from its current version to the latest or a specified version
facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/detec.downgrade_config: downgrade a detectron2 config CfgNode from its current version to an older specified version

facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/detec.get_cfg: get a copy of the default detectron2 CfgNode config instance
facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/detec.set_global_cfg: set the global config to point to a given CfgNode instance

facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/detec.load_LazyConfig: load a Python or YAML config file and return an omegaconf DictConfig object
facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/detec.save_LazyConfig: save an omegaconf config object to a YAML file with cloudpickle fallback
facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/detec.apply_overrides_LazyConfig: apply a list of override strings to in-place update config values
facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/detec.to_py_LazyConfig: convert an omegaconf config object into human-readable Python-like pseudo code
